main_text.l: Saxa suo qui stare loco dum viueret olimNon
Saxa olim Amphion mouit testudine: solo-
O Syperi imperio tu quoque saxa
mones.Saxa sed Amphion vane dispersa coegit,
Tu bene iuncta furens ordine saxa quatis.
Dedecus æternum sed tibi saxa dabunt.

page.notes: The bottom of the page shows faint show-through from the reverse side (ignored). The ornament (fleuron) is not text. The signature mark at lower right reads "H. ij" or similar and is partly unclear. The verse line "Saxa suo qui stare loco dum viueret olim" and "Non tulit, hoc saxo morinus opprimitur" may contain misprints (morinus likely for moritur); left as printed. "Syperi" as printed. The "s" in "dispersa" is a long s and is written as printed in the scan, but per rules should be plain s: "dispersa" should read "dispersa" in transcription; flagged here.
